final_plan.can_answer: yes, as a comparison of deaths recorded in police-reported crashes
final_plan.metric: annual totals of recorded motorist deaths and recorded cyclist deaths, calculated by summing the corresponding killed-count column across selected crash rows
final_plan.denominator: none; counts of deaths, not rates
final_plan.population: all police-reported NYC crash rows with crash_date in calendar years 2013–2025 inclusive
final_plan.years: calendar years 2013–2025 inclusive; all have dates from January 1 through December 31 in the file
final_plan.limitations: The measure is restricted to deaths recorded in police-reported crash rows and is not an independently verified death-registry total or an exposure-adjusted rate. Across all 2,269,187 file rows there are no missing dates or checked sentinel dates; January 1 dates (188–485 records per year) are retained as valid dates because the date field alone does not establish a default-date error.
